questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. It will be done by me.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

It will be done by me.

options.text: I will do it.
options.html: I will do it.

options.text: I do it.
options.html: I do it.

options.text: I did it.
options.html: I did it.

options.text: I have done it.
options.html: I have done it.

questions.solution:
Key Points

  • The given sentence is in the passive voice, indicated by the structure "It will be done by me."
  • To convert it into active voice, the subject who performs the action (in this case, "I") should be placed at the beginning of the sentence.
  • The main verb should change from "be done" (passive) to "do" (active), and the object of the action ("it") follows the verb.
  • The correct active voice conversion maintains the future tense, as indicated by "will do."

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: I will do it.

Additional Information

  • Option 2: "I do it." suggests a general or habitual action in the present tense, which doesn't convey the future aspect of the original sentence.
  • Option 3: "I did it." changes the sentence to past tense, which is not consistent with the future intention of the original sentence.
  • Option 4: "I have done it." uses the present perfect tense, which indicates an action completed at an unspecified time before now, not a future action.
